note: Annotations only (videos come from the source datasets). Dense-captioning records put templated queries at a timestamp and answer with the source events that ended before it (lane 'step' re-plots those spans); DiDeMo grounding records hold one query each, so example 2 gathers every record for one video. Some query timestamps lie past the video's end (e.g. 1305, 1005.1), apparently a sentinel for 'end of video'; DiDeMo spans are the source's 5-s chunks within the first 30 s. The clip is from TimeLens-100K's re-host of the same Flickr video.
